The '''''Impervious''''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].

==History==
It was constructed at the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] shipyards over [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. [[Shannon Voorson]] was able to slice its name, along with the names of several other Star Destroyers, and gave it to her cousin [[Deen Voorson]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
